categories.name: مسلسلات عراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi TV drama and comedy series from the 1960s to today: titles, writers, directors, actors and their famous characters, plots.

categories.name: أفلام ومسرحيات عراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi cinema films and theatre plays: titles, directors, actors, years, famous scenes.

categories.name: مطربون وأغانٍ عراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi singers and songs (text only, never quote more than a few words of lyrics): who sang which famous song, nicknames, maqam singers, composers, instruments.

categories.name: من القائل؟
categories.guide: Famous lines said by characters in Iraqi TV series, plays, cartoons dubbed in Arabic, or Arabic proverbs/poetry verses (short, under 12 words). Ask who said it or which work it is from. No political speeches.

categories.name: تلفزيون الزمن الجميل
categories.guide: Iraqi television and radio of the 1970s-1990s: old programs, presenters, children shows, sports programs, famous announcers. No political programs.

categories.name: احزر العمل من قصته
categories.guide: Describe the plot of a well known Iraqi or Arab TV series, film or play in 1-2 sentences without names; the answer is the title.

categories.name: كرة القدم العراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi football: national team history, Asian Cup 2007, Gulf Cup, World Cup 1986, clubs and their nicknames, stadiums, famous players and coaches.

categories.name: المنتخب العراقي
categories.guide: Iraq national football team only: tournaments, results, coaches, captains, records, youth and Olympic teams.

categories.name: الدوري والأندية العراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi league and clubs: club nicknames, cities, founding years, titles, stadiums, famous derbies, AFC Cup runs.

categories.name: كرة القدم العالمية
categories.guide: World football: World Cups, Champions League, famous players, clubs, transfers, records. Facts must be stable (not changing weekly).

categories.name: من أنا؟ رياضية
categories.guide: Riddle format: 2-3 first-person clues about a famous athlete (any sport, Iraqi or world). Answer is the person.

categories.name: أمثال شعبية
categories.guide: Iraqi popular proverbs: complete the proverb, or explain its meaning, or which situation it is said in.

categories.name: كلمات عراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi dialect words: meaning of a word, origin (Turkish/Persian/English loanwords), the Iraqi word for a standard Arabic word.

categories.name: لهجات المحافظات
categories.guide: Differences between Iraqi regional dialects (Baghdad, Basra, Mosul, south, west): which city says which word, how a word is pronounced. Respectful, no mocking any group.

categories.name: شعراء وأدباء عراقيون
categories.guide: Iraqi poets and writers, classical and modern: famous works, birthplaces, nicknames, movements (free verse). No political or sectarian content.

categories.name: محافظات ومدن
categories.guide: Iraqi provinces and cities: capitals of provinces, which city is in which province, rivers through cities, nicknames, famous products. Avoid disputed boundaries.

categories.name: معالم وآثار
categories.guide: Iraqi landmarks, monuments, archaeological sites, statues, bridges, mosques/churches as architecture only, UNESCO sites.

categories.name: تاريخ العراق القديم
categories.guide: Ancient Mesopotamia: Sumer, Akkad, Babylon, Assyria, Hatra, inventions, kings, gods (as history), epic of Gilgamesh, archaeology.

categories.name: أنهار وأهوار وطبيعة
categories.guide: Iraq rivers, marshes, lakes, dams, mountains, deserts, plants, animals and climate.

categories.name: جغرافيا العالم
categories.guide: World geography: capitals, countries, rivers, mountains, deserts, oceans, records.

categories.name: أعلام ودول
categories.guide: Flags and countries: describe a flag in words or show a flag image; colors, symbols, continents.

categories.name: أكلات عراقية
categories.guide: Iraqi food: dishes, ingredients, how they are cooked, breakfast, street food, regional specialities.

categories.name: حلويات ومشروبات
categories.guide: Iraqi sweets, desserts, bakeries and drinks: kleicha, zlabia, mann al-sama, tea culture, juices, regional sweets.

categories.name: أسواق ومهن قديمة
categories.guide: Old Iraqi markets and traditional professions: famous souqs in Baghdad and other cities, craftsmen, tools, street sellers.

categories.name: جيل الطيبين
categories.guide: Nostalgia for Iraq in the 1970s-2000s: games, devices, school life, cars, magazines, TV, money, home items. No political content.

categories.name: ألعاب شعبية
categories.guide: Traditional Iraqi children and adult games (mheibis, dagga, khtela, dabbal...), rules and names.

categories.name: رمضان والعيد
categories.guide: Ramadan and Eid customs in Iraq: food, mheibis, majina, eidiya, sweets, social habits. Customs only, nothing sectarian or doctrinal.

categories.name: معلومات عامة
categories.guide: General knowledge: science, geography, history of the world, records, language. Stable, verifiable facts only.

categories.name: علوم وطب
categories.guide: Science and medicine: body, chemistry, physics, space, inventions, inventors, health facts.

categories.name: عالم الحيوان
categories.guide: Animals: records, habitats, names of young, sounds, behaviours, Iraqi wildlife.

categories.name: قصص الأنبياء
categories.guide: Stories of the prophets as shared by Muslims and Christians (Noah, Abraham, Joseph, Moses, Jonah...): well known events only. Never sects, schools, or disputed matters.

categories.name: سيارات
categories.guide: Cars: brands, logos described in words, countries of origin, famous models, popular cars in Iraq.

categories.name: كرتون الطفولة
categories.guide: Classic cartoons and anime dubbed in Arabic (1980s-2010s, Spacetoon era) and Disney/Western cartoons: characters, names in Arabic dub, stories.

categories.name: أنمي
categories.guide: Anime and manga: Naruto, One Piece, Dragon Ball, Attack on Titan, Detective Conan, etc. Characters, abilities, studios.

categories.name: ألعاب إلكترونية
categories.guide: Video games popular in Iraq: PUBG, FIFA, GTA, Minecraft, Call of Duty, classic consoles; characters, publishers, release years.

categories.name: من أنا؟
categories.guide: Riddle format: 2-3 first-person clues about a famous person, place, animal, object or food (Iraqi or world). Answer is the thing.

categories.name: صورة مقرّبة
categories.guide: Show a close-up crop of a common object/animal/food; question is what is this? Answer is the object. Always image with zoom.

categories.name: رتّبها
categories.guide: Ask to order 3-4 items (by date, size, length, population). Answer lists the correct order.

categories.name: صحّح الخطأ
categories.guide: Give a statement with one deliberate factual error; the team must say what is wrong and correct it. Answer gives the correction.

categories.name: الجواب بكلمتين
categories.guide: Questions whose answer is exactly two words (a person, place, dish, title).

categories.name: إي لو لا؟
categories.guide: A surprising statement; answer is yes or no (إي or لا) followed by a very short correction if no.

categories.name: ولا كلمة
categories.guide: Charades: the host shows a word to one player who acts it silently. Question text: مثّل بدون كلام: <word>. Answer: the word. Words are Iraqi items, food, professions, films, actions. 200 easy, 600 hard.
